The name can be seen as a nod to the Christian belief in the renewal and redemption through the grace of God. Raye implies a sense of continuous flow, as if the individual bearing the name is moving forward, with the divine support and guidance of God.
data.spiritual_significance: In a more spiritual context, the name Raye signifies the feminine qualities of a divine being. It is a symbol of the gentle, nurturing, and creative force of the Christian God. Raye carries a sense of hope and resilience, representing the idea that even in the darkest times, the light of faith will always flow and sustain individuals on their spiritual journey.
